question: Use Primer3 to design PCR primers for human FOXP3 mRNA: primer length 18-22 nt (opt 20), Tm 58-62 degrees C (opt 60 degrees C), GC content 40-60%, product size 200-300 bp. Return the top 5 primer pairs.

expected_output.guidelines: Sequences must match the reference exactly; Tm within +/-0.5, positions and product size within +/-1 bp; column order and header labels may differ.
